games.name: School Grounds, Fairwater
games.desc:
Fairwater School is an English-medium comprehensive school in South Wales, catering to students aged 11 to 16. We focus on both academic success and personal development, guided by our core values: Resilience, Authority, Discipline, Focus, and Diligence. These principles are central to our approach, helping students excel in both their studies and personal growth.

We strive to create a dynamic learning environment that encourages critical thinking and teamwork through roleplay and practical experiences. These activities provide students with essential life skills, preparing them for future challenges both academically and personally.

Sessions start at 20:15

games.name: Derby! | Uma Musume [Open Playtest]
games.desc:
Inspired by Uma Musume.

NOTE: This Game is in Playtest, expect lots of Bugs and feel free to report the Bugs to me!

CONTROLS (PC):
- M to open Menu.

RACE CONTROLS (PC):
- Press Space to Sprint.
- When Sprinting, Hold Space then Release at the right Timing to Spurt.
- W,A,S,D to Change Direction/Turn.

CONSOLE CONTROLS:
- Press A to Sprint
- When Sprinting, Hold A then Release at the right Timing to Spurt.

MOBILE IS ALSO SUPPORTED!

Reroll your Trait at Trait Research in Menu.
It's Recommended to check your Stats to learn how your Trait Abilities Work.

Playtest Feature: You get free 3 Licenses at the Start, Participate in a Race or Predict other Player to earn License.

#Umamusume
